g.text: Complex-line translations and a computable scaling limit
Input q(ζ) = |Im ζ|, direction y = 1. Twice the middle-panel area is the average at s = −1.
Exact values at s = −1: t = 1 → 1; t = 2 → 1/2; t = 4 → 5/8; t = 8 → 25/32. The fixed center is held still as t increases.
